# Colby Mainard — Personal Website

> Personal website and professional portfolio of Colby Mainard, a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and applied AI for sports analytics, cybersecurity, and financial technology. The site documents his work history, education, projects, technical skills, certifications, technical opinions, beginner-friendly guides, curated learning resources, and hobbies.

Colby Mainard is an AI/ML Engineer (currently at RiskScout). He holds an Masters in Computer Science from Texas A&M University — concentrating in artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision — and a B.S. in Computer Science from Texas A&M with minors in Business and Cybersecurity.

Core expertise: computer vision, deep learning, natural language processing, generative models (GANs, VAEs, transformers), reinforcement learning, and security-focused ML (fraud detection, anomaly detection, anti-money laundering). Common tools: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, SQL, AWS, and Docker.

**Canonical URL:** https://colbymainard.github.io/

**Last updated:** 2026-06-29

## Site notes

- Static site: client-side HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only — no backend, server-side processing, or API.
- Intended audience: potential colleagues, technical recruiters, fellow AI/ML enthusiasts, and computer science students.

## Pages

- [Home / Professional Background](https://colbymainard.github.io/index.html): Work history, education, projects, certifications, technical skills, and contact information.
- [Guides](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/guides.html): Plain-spoken starter guides for newcomers to data engineering, computer vision, generative AI, natural language processing, reinforcement learning, software engineering, and cybersecurity.
- [Technical Stances](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_takes.html): Long-form opinion pieces on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, cryptocurrency security, the future of quantum computing, AGI hype, post-internet privacy, and product placement in sports marketing.
- [Technical Resources](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/tech_resources.html): Curated reading lists and learning resources covering cybersecurity, AI/ML, C/C++, Python, scripting, and operating systems.
- [Hobbies](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/hobbies.html): Photography, quantum-computing self-study, Dungeons & Dragons, and history.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://colbymainard.github.io/assets/html/privacy.html): How the site handles cookies, analytics, and visitor data.
